title: Goods in Administrator
company: MET Recruitment UK LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Goods In Administrator

Location: Wolverhampton
Job Type: Full Time, Temp to Perm
Pay Rate: £12.90 per hour

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the smooth running of the goods-in and goods-out process, ensuring stock and deliveries are accurately recorded and processed.

- Updating relevant systems and maintaining accurate records
- Checking paperwork and delivery information
- Liaising with warehouse and operational teams to ensure goods are processed efficiently
- Supporting other areas of the warehouse/operation during quieter periods
- Carrying out general administrative and operational duties as required

About You

We are looking for someone who is:
- Organised and detail-oriented
- Reliable and punctual
- Comfortable working in a busy environment
- Confident using computer systems and completing administrative tasks
- Able to work well as part of a team
- Flexible and willing to support other areas when required
- Previous experience in a goods-in, warehouse administration, logistics or similar role is essential.

What's on Offer
- £12.90 per hour
- Full-time hours
- Temp-to-perm opportunity
- Opportunity to develop within a busy operational environment
- Supportive team environment

Interested?

If you are interested in this opportunity, please get in touch with Tegan Young at (url removed) to find out more or apply.

title: Operations Coordinator
company: Pertemps Black Country Perms - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operational activities of the business. The role will be responsible for coordinating sales administration, stock control, export documentation, logistics management, ERP system administration, and customer service activities to ensure smooth and efficient business operations. The successful candidate will work closely with internal departments, suppliers, warehouses, freight providers, and customers to maintain high service levels and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate daily operational activities to ensure efficient order processing and fulfilment.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently through ERP systems.
- Generate quotations, sales orders, invoices, credit notes, and other customer documentation.
- Monitor stock levels and maintain accurate inventory records within ERP systems.
- Track inventory movements, stock adjustments, and replenishment requirements.
- Liaise with warehouse teams to investigate stock discrepancies and implement corrective actions.
- Produce stock reports and forecasts to support planning and procurement activities.
- Monitor product shelf life and minimise risks associated with aged or obsolete stock.
- Support ERP system improvements, testing, and implementation projects.
- Prepare export documentation including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates, and customs paperwork.
- Ensure compliance with export regulations, customs requirements, and international trading standards.
- Coordinate domestic and international shipments with freight forwarders, hauliers, and logistics partners.
- Track shipments and provide customers with delivery updates.
- Work closely with warehouse teams to ensure accurate and timely dispatch of goods.
- Deliver exceptional customer service by handling enquiries, complaints, and order-related issues.
- Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, logistics providers, and internal stakeholders.
- Support with reporting and process improvements

Key Skills
- Previous experience in an Operations Coordinator, Sales Administrator, Customer Service, Logistics, Export, or Supply Chain role.
- Strong knowledge of stock control and inventory management processes.
- Experience using ERP systems for order processing and inventory management.
- Knowledge of export documentation and international shipping procedures.
- Excellent administrative and organisational skills.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including reporting and data analysis.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

If you have a background in international operations, stock control, ERP systems, sales support, export or logistics coordination this could be the role for you.

title: Customer Service Advisor

- Maintain a strong and up to date working knowledge of all processes relating to relevant products and services.
- To work collaboratively with your peer group and other colleagues sharing best practice.
- When appropriate, seeks opportunities to add value to the customer and build customer loyalty through the promotion of My Policy products and services.

- Establish and communicate high standards of customer service in line with the company's values and culture.
- Establish and communicate high standards of customer service in line with the company's values and culture.

- Contribute to an open and honest culture within teams through collaborative and supportive working.
- Support a culture of continuous improvement for Customer experience, and operating systems.

What we're looking for:
- Strong Communicator

title: Office Administrator
description:
Office Administrator

We are recruiting for an Office Administrator to join a well-established organisation based in Walsall.

This is a varied role combining billing administration, file management and general office support, making it ideal for someone who is highly organised, accurate and enjoys working in a busy office environment.

As the Office Administrator, you will be responsible for:
- Checking files to ensure time and travel records are accurate
- Creating and inputting Legal Aid bills using the case management system
- Managing online billing submissions, including Mental Health billing
- Archiving files once payment has been received
- Managing petty cash and files returned from Costs Draftsmen
- Archiving, retrieving and returning files to storage
- Providing reception cover, including answering calls and meeting visitors
- Processing incoming and outgoing post
- Ordering stationery and office supplies
- Maintaining accurate administrative records
- Supporting the Office Manager with general administrative duties
- Providing occasional support at the Aldridge office

The successful Office Administrator will have the following related skills / experience:
- Have strong administration and IT skills
- Be highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Be accurate and confident working with records and data
- Have a proactive and flexible approach to work
- Be comfortable working in a busy, varied environment
- Previous experience within a legal, billing or professional services environment would be advantageous

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking to recruit a receptionist to join our reception team within the Sexual Health Service. The role will encompass dealing with patients, clinical and non-clinical staff by face to face and telephone; subsequently you will require excellent communications skills. A flexible approach to this role is essential to ensure the demands of the service are met. As part of the team you will be registering patients onto the clinic computer system whereby accuracy is essential. Working knowledge of all common computer applications including word is essential, as you will be required to carry out a wide range of transactions and associated data input. Specialist training will be given on 'in house' systems. You should have a good standard of general education and have attained qualifications in English & Mathematics e.g. GSCE or equivalent. You will also require a clear understanding of the concept of confidentiality of personal health information. The role will encompass dealing with patients, clinical and non-clinical staff by face to face and telephone; subsequently you will require excellent communications skills. A flexible approach to this role is essential to ensure the demands of the service are met. As part of the team you will be registering patients onto the Trust computer system whereby accuracy is essential.
